definitions.explanation: A residence other than one's main home. Can refer to a secondary house maintained for work, family reasons, or personal circumstances. Sometimes carries the connotation of a dwelling kept for a mistress or secret relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別宅|べったく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has a separate residence in central Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別宅|べったく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I rented a second home near the office for work reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{晩年|ばんねん}→晩年：27495_bannen⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別宅|べったく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In his later years, my grandfather often spent time at his separate residence in the quiet countryside.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate, different) and ⟦{宅|たく}→宅：12302_taku⟧ (residence). Unlike ⟦{別荘|べっそう}→別荘：11786_bessou⟧ (vacation home), {別宅|べったく} implies a practical secondary residence rather than a leisure property.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別宅|べったく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ — to set up a separate residence
- {別宅|べったく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ — to have a second home
- {別宅|べったく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ — to live at a separate residence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別荘|べっそう}→別荘：11786_bessou⟧ — vacation home, villa; used for leisure and relaxation, typically in resort areas
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ — one's own home (primary residence)
- ⟦{本宅|ほんたく}→本宅：28950_hontaku⟧ — main residence (as opposed to a secondary one)
- セカンドハウス — second house (loanword, more neutral and modern)

USAGE:
In some contexts, {別宅|べったく} carries an implication that the separate residence is maintained for a secret romantic relationship, especially in older or literary usage. The phrase {別宅|べったく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ can be a euphemism for keeping a mistress. In modern usage, however, it often simply means a secondary residence for practical purposes like commuting.
